Name: Shortcuts Restored
Author: CaptainExpendable
Description:
[u][size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size][/u]

This mod adds the shortcut path from south of the museum to the tide pools and the bridge from the lake island to in front of the mines, to be available at the start of the game rather than having to be purchased from the community upgrades added in 1.6. If you're about to buy the community upgrade for the rest of the shortcuts maybe remove this mod first. I have tested it with the mod and it worked fine but I think it would be better just in case.

[u][b][size=5]More Info[/size][/b][/u]

This is my first mod, I don't know how to code or make a more complex mod so it is a simple content patcher mod. This unfortunately means it [b]will conflict[/b] with any mod that affects the town, beach, or mountain maps. [b]I cannot help or fix that[/b]. Look, this mod was made for personal satisfaction as I like these shortcuts but do not want to wait until I finish the community center, fully upgrade my house, and then Pam's. I find these short cuts most useful in early game and practically pointless late game. Also I find manually replacing the files and backing up the originals to be annoying so the mod seemed simpler.

*Note: These are not the exact same shortcuts from stardew expanded - shortcuts, just inspired by it as I used to use it. No asset or layout of assets was taken or used to make this mod. These are the short cuts already in the game I just edited the maps so they're there by default. Also I use the honor system in my own game but if you wanted to use this to get to the tide pools or mine early, go for it!

[b][size=5][u]How to install:[/u][/size][/b]

[size=3]1. Install the latest version of SMAPI
2. Install the latest version of Content Patcher
3. Extract and place into your mods folder[/size]
